36331190.source: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03594110 (EMPA-KIDNEY) posted results, adverse events module, serious adverse event term 'Diabetic ketoacidosis' (MedDRA 20.1): EG001 'Empagliflozin 10 mg' 5 of 3304 at risk; EG000 'Placebo' 1 of 3305 at risk (held: evidence/typed_arms/registry/NCT03594110.json). SINGLE-TRIAL harm datum (k=1): DAPA-CKD and CREDENCE expose no per-arm DKA counts through the committed fetch path.
